description.en: OpenCode Go usage windows and model listing carried by the provider plugin.
description.zh: 由 Provider 插件提供 OpenCode Go 用量窗口与模型目录。

description.en: Sign in with the OpenCode Console device code, or paste a Console API key. The same credential serves requests and refreshes the Go quota windows.
description.zh: 用 OpenCode Console 设备码登录，或直接填写 Console API 密钥。同一凭证既用于推理也用于刷新 Go 用量窗口。

help_text.en: Optional. A Console API key from opencode.ai/console, for an account that signs in with a key instead of the browser. Leave blank to use the device login.
help_text.zh: 可选。opencode.ai/console 生成的 Console API 密钥，用于以密钥代替浏览器登录的账号；留空即走设备码登录。
